description: This file defines a Perl module 'Coocook::Controller::Error' which handles various error responses such as 400 Bad Request, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, and 500 Internal Server Error within a web application. It includes methods for rendering error pages and controlling response status and headers.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Error
classes.description: A controller class for handling various error responses in the web application.

methods.name: bad_request
methods.description: Handles 400 Bad Request errors, rendering an error message or Ajax response.

methods.name: forbidden
methods.description: Handles 403 Forbidden errors, rendering an error message.

methods.name: internal_server_error
methods.description: Handles 500 Internal Server Error, serving a static error page if enabled.

methods.name: page_not_found
methods.description: Handles 404 Page Not Found errors for pages.

methods.name: not_found
methods.description: Generic handler for 404 errors, setting response status and rendering a not_found template.
